business_problem: scale ad hoc analytics and regulatory reporting for billions of financial records while lowering compute costs and avoiding the limits of legacy warehouse platforms.
solution_summary: Intercontinental Exchange and NYSE uses Snowflake and Snowpark on Snowflake to scale ad hoc analytics and regulatory reporting for billions of financial records while lowering compute costs and avoiding the limits of legacy warehouse platforms. High-volume trading and transaction data from ICE and NYSE systems are centralized on Snowflake for analysis and compliance reporting. Snowpark runs the in-platform processing needed for regulatory reporting so the firms can analyze and transform very large record sets without exporting them to a separate stack. Business and reporting teams use the shared environment for ad hoc analysis at scale while governance-sensitive regulatory workloads run with lower cost and better performance. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI. ICE improved ad hoc reporting performance by up to 80%...

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

data_flow: trading and transaction data flow into Snowflake and Snowpark; curated data and model outputs are then served to analysts and regulatory reporting teams.
business_outcome: ICE improved ad hoc reporting performance by up to 80% and the NYSE cut regulatory reporting data costs by more than 50% within one month of moving that workload to Snowpark.
